messages.subject: Verdant v Calderhall - draft Letter Before Action for approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Nadia,

Please find attached the draft Letter Before Action to Calderhall for your approval, together with the draft Schedule of Loss it refers to. The LBA gives Calderhall 14 days to respond and expressly puts them on notice of the clause 9 repair/replace point.

Grateful for any comments by end of tomorrow so we can get this out on Friday. Figures in the schedule total 2,475,200 - please sense-check the EPC LD and lost-revenue numbers against your records.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
